title: Recital at Warbler's Nest
wikitext:
{{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW Recital at Warbler's Nest.png |caption= |type= Shrine |game= BotW |giver= [[Kheel]] |location= Rito Village |prereq= |reward= [[Voo Lota Shrine]] |previous= {{Color BotW|Side Quest|[[Find Kheel]]}} |next= }} "{{Term/Store|Recital at Warbler's Nest||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Shrine Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|Recital at Warbler's Nest}}
{{Color BotW|Shrine Quest|Rito Village}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== When [[Link]] searches [[Warbler's Nest]] at [[Amali]]'s request,{{Cite|Maybe she went to {{Color BotW|Red|Warbler's Nest}} to practice her singing?|Amali|BotW}} he will find [[Kheel]] stewing in her anger.{{Cite|Pikyeeeehh!!!|Kheel|BotW}} She is upset that her sisters are missing their rehearsal,{{Cite|{{Big|Grrrrrr! My sisters are dumb DUMMIES!}} They promised we'd rehearse together, but NO ONE showed up!|Kheel|BotW}} as they have to perform their song for the elder, [[Kaneli]].{{Cite|We have to perform our song for the {{Color BotW|Blue|elder}} at {{Color BotW|Red|Warbler's Nest}}! We're going to be laughed off the stage...|Kheel|BotW}} Noticing Link, Kheel realizes that she can use him to her advantage.{{Cite|Hey, you... You look like I can use you... Thaaaat is to say...you look like a nice guy who likes to help people in need.|Kheel|BotW}} Kheel asks Link to retrieve her sisters from [[Rito Village]],{{Cite|Can you go tell my sisters in Rito Village to stop ditching rehearsal?|Kheel|BotW}} as they are more likely to listen to a scary [[Hylian]] than her.{{Cite|They won't listen to me, but they might listen to a scary-looking Hylian like you.|Kheel|BotW}} However, she suspects her sister [[Genli]] will refuse to come unless she has [[Salmon Meunière]].{{Cite|Although Genli might be a tough sell. She's probably in the {{Color BotW|Red|kitchen}} yelling, {{Big|"I want some {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}}!"}} ...or something like that.|Kheel|BotW}} Genli also does not want to sing, which Kheel finds annoying.{{Cite|She doesn't want to sing either... She's such a pain!|Kheel|BotW}} After Kheel finishes speaking, the [[Shrine Quest]] begins. In the [[Kitchen (Location)|Kitchen]] of Rito Village, Genli will be demanding Salmon Meunière, just as Kheel predicted.{{Cite|Hurry! Hurry! {{Big|I NEED {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}} in my belly!}}|Genli|BotW}} She will not attend rehearsal with Kheel until she has some.{{Cite|I know {{Color BotW|Blue|Kheel}} wants me to practice singing with her, but I just can't. Not until I get my {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}}!|Genli|BotW}} Their other three sisters have already set out to gather ingredients for her Salmon Meunière,{{Cite|My sisters already left to get {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}} ingredients.|Genli|BotW}} which Genli did not expect them to do.{{Cite|I told them I wouldn't sing until I get it. I didn't expect them to actually make it for me, though!|Genli|BotW}} While she does not want to sing, Genli will not refuse Salmon Meunière.{{Cite|I don't want to practice singing...
{{Small|but I really do want some yummy {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}}.}}|Genli|BotW}} Genli wonders what is taking her sisters so long, as they were only going to [[The Slippery Falcon]].{{Cite|What is taking my sisters so long? I thought they were just going to the {{Color BotW|Red|Slippery Falcon}}.|Genli|BotW}} The rest of the sisters can be found throughout Rito Village. [[Cree]] will be in The Slippery Falcon, where she has purchased [[Goat Butter]].{{Cite|♪Yah yah!♪
♪I bought some {{Color BotW|Blue|goat butter}}!♪|Cree|BotW}} When Link reminds her of her rehearsal, Cree realizes that she forgot she was supposed to attend.{{Cite|...Huh? Rehearsal? Oh, yeah! I forgot!|Cree|BotW}} She gives Link the Goat Butter on the condition that he make Salmon Meunière for Genli.{{Cite|If I give you this {{Color BotW|Blue|goat butter}}, will you make some {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}} for Genli? She should be in the {{Color BotW|Red|kitchen}}. She said she won't sing until she's eaten.|Cree|BotW}} Cree thinks that her sister [[Notts]] is practicing her songs somewhere high up,{{Cite|Our older sister Notts is probably practicing her songs somwhere up {{Color BotW|Red|high}}.|Cree|BotW}} while she remembers that [[Kotts]] went to catch [[Hearty Salmon]]s at the pond near Rito Village's entrance.{{Cite|Kotts left to catch some {{Color BotW|Blue|hearty salmon}}. She's probably fishing at the {{Color BotW|Red|pond}} near the entrance to the village.|Cree|BotW}} Next, Link can find Notts singing on one of the ledges on the Village's spire.{{Cite|♪La la loo loo la la!♪
♪La la la, loo loo!♪
♪La la laaaaaaa la la!♪|Notts|BotW}} She calls her song, "Return of the Bird-Wrangling Hero... First Movement" and thanks Link for listening to her.{{Cite|I call that song...
"Return of the Bird-Wrangling Hero... First Movement." Thanks for listening!|Notts|BotW}} When Link reminds her of rehearsal, she claims that she did not forget and was instead searching for ingredients for Genli's Salmon Meunière.{{Cite|What? Singing rehearsal at {{Color BotW|Red|Warbler's Nest}}? I didn't forget! It's just that Genli really wanted some {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}}, so my sisters and I have been looking for ingredients.|Notts|BotW}} However, she finished early, so she has started practicing while she waited.{{Cite|I finished early, so I was practicing here to kill time.|Notts|BotW}} Notts feels bad that she made Kheel wait,{{Cite|I feel bad we left Kheel waiting, though. I really should head over to rehearsal.|Notts|BotW}} so she gives her [[Tabantha Wheat]] to Link and asks him to make Salmon Meunière for Genli.{{Cite|Well then...I guess I'll give the {{Color BotW|Blue|Tabantha wheat}} to you! Please make the best {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}} for Genli!|Notts|BotW}} She also reveals that she does not reveal Genli's excuse that she is hungry.{{Cite|She says she can't sing on an empty stomach, but I'm pretty sure that's just an excuse. Well, good luck!|Notts|BotW}} Kotts can be found splashing in the water of one of the ponds near Rito Village's entrance, where she explains she is fishing for Hearty Salmon.{{Cite|Hiyah! HIYAH!
I'm fishing for {{Color BotW|Blue|hearty salmon}}!|Kotts|BotW}} She is shocked when Link reminds her of rehearsal, having forgotten due to her focus on catching fish.{{Cite|...Huh? What are you doing here? What? Rehearsal? AHHH! I totally forgot! I was too focused on catching these fish.|Kotts|BotW}} Afraid of Kheel's wrath,{{Cite|Kheel's going to kill me!|Kotts|BotW}} she gives Link the Hearty Salmon she caught so he can make Salmon Meunière for Genli.{{Cite|Please take this {{Color BotW|Blue|hearty salmon}} and go make some {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}} for Genli.|Kotts|BotW}} Kotts hopes that Genli will be able to sing after she eats.{{Cite|Hopefully she'll feel like singing after she has some.|Kotts|BotW}} With all of the ingredients he has been given, Link will be able to make Hearty Salmon Meunière for Genli. She will be able to smell the meal in his [[Inventory]],{{Cite|*sniff sniff...* *sniff sniff sniff* That amazing smell... Could it be? {{Big|Sa... Sa... {{Color BotW|Blue|Salmon meunière}}?!}}|Genli|BotW}} at which point she asks to have some.{{Cite|You're going to let me have some, right? RIGHT?!|Genli|BotW}} If Link gives it to her, Genli will excitedly eat it.{{Cite|[Enjoy!] YAAAAAAAAAAAAY! ♪Time to dig in!♪ *munch munch* Hngh mngh... Hnff! Hurk! Mmmmmm... I'm stuffed!|Genli|BotW}} When Link reminds her she should be at rehearsal, Genli decides that she should not break her promise.{{Cite|...Huh? My promise to my sisters? I suppose I shouldn't break my promise...|Genli|BotW}} While she enjoys singing, she admits that she is nervous when she has to do so in front of others.{{Cite|I really DO like singing!
...But I am too nervous to sing in front of other people.|Genli|BotW}} Genli thinks that singing with her sisters may help with her stage fright.{{Cite|I have SERIOUS stage fright...but maybe practicing with my sisters will help me feel more comfortable.|Genli|BotW}} She thanks Link for the Salmon Meunière before leaving to Warbler's Nest.{{Cite|Anyway, thank you for the amazing {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}}! It was so soft and flaky and delicious! I'll give this rehearsal my all. ♪Come listen later!♪|Genli|BotW}} When Link returns to Warbler's Nest, he will find all five sisters singing together. Kheel thanks Link for retrieving her sisters{{Cite|Oh, thank you so much! All of my sisters are here!|Kheel|BotW}} She reveals that they are singing an ancient song that has been sung at Warbler's Nest for generations.{{Cite|Now we can rehearse here at {{Color BotW|Red|Warbler's Nest}}! Want to know what song we're singing? Well...the {{Color BotW|Blue|elder}} told me... It's a song passed down in the Rito Village that was once sung at {{Color BotW|Red|Warbler's Nest}} in ancient times.|Kheel|BotW}} In case Link was unaware, she informs him that Warbler's Nest is comprised of the [[Pedestal]] and pillars behind them.{{Cite|If you didn't know, {{Color BotW|Red|Warbler's Nest}} is the big stone platform with the pillars behind us.|Kheel|BotW}} While the lyrics do not make sense to Kheel, she is interested in the line that states the [[Monk]]'s door will open when wind makes the rocks sing.{{Cite|The lyrics don't make a lot of sense, but there's one line in particular that always catches my ear... "When wind convinces the rocks to sing, open the monk's door will swing."|Kheel|BotW}} She asks Link what he thinks it means.{{Cite|What do you think that means? What's a monk?|Kheel|BotW}} Suddenly, Kheel remembers that she got something for Link to thank him.{{Cite|Oh! And I almost forgot! I got you a little something. Just a small thanks for bringing all of my sisters here.|Kheel|BotW}} She gifts Link a [[Korok Leaf]],{{Cite|{{Big|Ta-da! A {{Color BotW|Red|Korok leaf}}!}}|Kheel|BotW}} revealing it will make a fun noise if he swings it towards Warbler's Nest.{{Cite|Why don't you swing it in the direction of {{Color BotW|Red|Warbler's Nest}}? It makes a fun noise!|Kheel|BotW}} The sisters each sing one note in a particular order: Cree, Kheel, Genli, Notts, and lastly Kotts. The pillars at Warbler's Nest all correspond to one of them, the number of spires on top of it respresenting both their place in line and their birth order. While standing on the Pedestal, Link must swing the Korok Leaf in the pattern given to him by the sisters, this being four, five, three, one, and two. This will cause [[Voo Lota Shrine]] to rise from the ground.{{Cite|You solved the mystery behind the Rito Village song and Warbler's nest, uncovering an ancient shrine in the process!|Adventure Log|BotW}} Turning around, Kheel beckons her sisters to look at the Shrine.{{Cite|Wow! Hey look, guys!|Kheel|BotW}} Cree is confused and wonders whether the "weird-looking house" was always there,{{Cite|Huh? Was that weird-looking house always there?|Cree|BotW}} but Kotts recognizes it as an [[Ancient Shrine]].{{Cite|No, that's that "shrine" thing that the elder was talking about!|Kotts|BotW}} Genli remarks how cool it is that Warbler's Nest had such a secret,{{Cite|So cool! Who knew Warbler's Nest was keeping a secret like that!|Genli|BotW}} and so Notts decides they have to tell their mother,{{Cite|Let's tell Mom!|Notts|BotW}} Kheel agrees with her,{{Cite|Yeah, let's!|Kheel|BotW}} turning back to say goodbye to Link.{{Cite|See ya later!|Kheel|BotW}} Kotts challenges her sisters to a race,{{Cite|Last one to mom is an unhatched egg!|Kotts|BotW}}{{Cite|Ready, set...GO!|Kheel|BotW}} and so the five of them fly off back to Rito Village. Once they are gone, the Shrine Quest will be completed, and Link will be able to access Voo Lota Shrine. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | Kheel, youngest of the five sisters inhabiting Rito Village, is furious that her sisters haven't shown up for singing practice.

Go find her eldest sister, Notts, second-eldest sister, Kotts, third-eldest sister, Genli, and fourth eldest sister, Cree, {{Color BotW|Red|somewhere in Rito Village}}, and tell them to meet Kheel. |- | 2 | You made salmon meunière for Genli, improving her mood considerably.

Go check on her sisters, who went to {{Color BotW|Red|Warbler's Nest}}. |- | 3 | The five sisters sung an ancient song passed down in the Rito Village that goes:

"When wind convinces the rocks to sing,
open the monk's door will swing."

There could be a secret hidden in the song's lyrics. |- | Complete | You solved the mystery behind the Rito Village song and Warbler's nest, uncovering an ancient shrine in the process!

The sisters, thrilled to practice their song and find a secret, went back to Rito Village. }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Voo Lota Shrine Exterior.png|Voo Lota Shrine ==See Also== {{See Also| * Cree * Genli * Kheel * Kotts * Notts * Warbler's Nest * Voo Lota Shrine }} {{Notes}} {{Ref}} {{Categories |shrine-quests= BotW }}
